correctness.rationale: For n>1 with r=ω(n) known, d_t(n)=Σ_{j=1}^t binom(t,j)c_j(n) by placement of nonunit factors, while exact Euler/stars-and-bars count d_t=∏_{i=1}^r binom(t+a_i−1,a_i). Therefore H_n(T)=∏(T+a_i), monic degree r, satisfies H_n(t)=t^r d_{t+1}/d_t at t=1,…,r. Equality of c_1,…,c_{r+1} forces equality at r points of two monic polynomials, hence identical H and negative integer roots a_i; converse follows from invertible binomial transform. Checked small-support sharpness pairs (1)/(2), (1,5)/(2,3), (1,6,8)/(2,2,13), and (3,7,11,74)/(4,4,17,63), with equality only through r counts. No general optimality asserted for r>4.
